verdict.rationale: Self-hosting a voice agent runtime from open-source code is a fair question for a voice AI platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only describes telli as a hosted platform reached through its app, REST API, webhooks and MCP server. Importing numbers from your own SIP trunk or forwarding calls is adjacent telephony integration, not self-hosting the runtime, and nothing shows open-source code or on-premise deployment.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can self-host the voice agent runtime from open-source code on my own infrastructure
